metric_definitions.overall: 14 fixed non-null scenarios, 200 paired replicates each; equally weighted scenario means
metric_definitions.precision: sum TP / sum selected across all 3000; undefined when no selected features
metric_definitions.mcse: SE of equally weighted scenario-specific paired means: sqrt(sum_s sample_var(d_s)/n_s)/14

definition.interval: Unadjusted descriptive 95% Monte Carlo t interval for the paired mean; n=50 per scenario
definition.curve_scope: Known true factors and true direction; ranking uses the original known-count scoring task

study.design: Eight-model comparison under common synthetic designs and evaluation procedures
